newsitem.title: UK: Allied Colloids buys DuPont pulp technology.
newsitem.headline: Allied Colloids buys DuPont pulp technology.

text.p: British chemicals company Allied Colloids Group Plc and Sweden's Eka Chemicals, part of Dutch group Akzo Nobel NV, said on Tuesday they had acquired Particol Silica Microgel technology from DuPont Co of the U.S.
In a statement the companies said they would be able to use the technology, used in the production of pulp, paper, paperboard and laminates, and trademarks world-wide.
The statement said the agreement ended all outstanding legal disputes between the companies over the technology.
